description: Different model profiles should preserve route-specific FastAPI client evidence, integration-level extension, and app-wiring deferral.

lockedFields.reason: The FastAPI fixture must preserve its repo-native pytest command.
The exact client request already provides bounded route evidence, so the route should not require a new test file.
The covered route should remain an edge-case extension candidate.
Application wiring should remain deferred to route-level coverage.
The exact client-to-route match should produce a stable extend-test item.
HTTP route behavior belongs at the integration level.
The route recommendation must retain the matching FastAPI client test.
The route must retain its framework-client evidence kind.
A client request remains bounded indirect evidence rather than a direct source import.
The visibly asserted response should retain asserted usage.
FastAPI application wiring should remain deferred to route or integration tests.

unexpectedVariations: new-test recommendation for the covered route
